description: Update transaction metadata fields such as counterparty name, bank account number, description, or payment reference. Importer markers in the stored description are preserved. The bank reference (bank_ref_number) is read-only in the API and is refused. Verify the change with a fresh get_transaction before reporting it as repaired.

data.description: Object with allowed metadata fields only: bank_account_name, bank_account_no, description (max 150 chars incl. preserved importer markers), ref_number (canonicalized like create_transaction). bank_ref_number is read-only and refused.

name: update_transaction
title: Update Transaction
